propositions: The scheduled Reconcile Bridge GitHub Action fails with 'failed to parse JQL query: the value leg does not exist for the field project' when the live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json contains nonexistent project keys (LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO) from a rehearsal fixture instead of the canonical empty projects mapping.

The multi-project fan-out in fetcher._build_snapshot builds one inbound JQL query per key in projects.json; when projects.json maps nonexistent Jira projects, the first query issues an invalid project clause that Jira rejects, causing ACLI to exit 1 and the reconcile pass to abort.

The live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json was corrupted by ad-hoc git commits (9f1b2cff98 and 275bd7507e) authored with the test-fixture identity, overwriting the canonical state {version:1, legacy_default:REB, projects:{}} with a rehearsal fixture mapping.

The canonical projects.json state (empty projects dict with REB as legacy_default) must be restored to live origin/tickets so that the fan-out fallback uses only the single configured project REB instead of attempting queries for nonexistent mapped keys.
